name: Woodworks Distilling Co
old_description: The story of craft distilling has been told down through the ages. Woodworks Distilling Company was founded to build on the roots of this time-honored legacy: small batches, local ingredients, artisanal attention.
about:
Woodworks Distilling Co. operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where founders Dave Wood and David Alexander launched the craft distillery after years of experience in retail, warehousing, and the brewing industry. Wood, the CEO, had long envisioned the venture, while Alexander brings expertise as a chemist, regulatory specialist, and cocktail designer. The company does not disclose a founding year or ownership structure such as family or veteran status.

The distillery produces a range of spirits including 100% corn vodka distilled six times, a four-grain vodka, dry and barrel-aged gins, sourced bourbon and rye whiskeys under the Preface Series, and corn-based liqueurs such as Apple Pie Corn Liquor through its Horns Down Fine Spirits partnership. Emphasis is placed on small batches, local ingredients, and wood influence throughout aging and flavor development. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not publicly specified.

Products are sold to retail consumers, bars, and restaurants, with distribution expanding through the Horns Down alliance. The company also operates an event space at its Britton Road location, hosting weddings, live music, chef dinners, and private functions managed by Front of House Manager Abbey Elliot. Contract distilling services are offered to partner brands.

Woodworks positions itself on storytelling—each spirit reflects provenance, process, and passion, with wood shaping every facet. The founders state they started the distillery because they believe customers seek distinctive experiences and that they themselves are "distinctive spirits" looking for novel tastes.

name: Workers LLC
old_description: was founded to serve the meat processing industry with reliability, expertise, and personal service. From day one, we've helped customers purchase new equipment, repair existing machinery, and stock the right parts to keep production running without interruption.
about:
Workers LLC, based in Neenah, Wisconsin, was founded to serve the meat processing industry with a focus on reliability, expertise, and personal service. The company operates from a facility on Smith Street and has built a reputation as a local source for equipment, parts, and support.

The company distributes food processing and packaging equipment from brands such as Hollymatic, Sipromac, Talsa, Risco, Rice Lake, Bizerba, and TSC, along with vacuum pouches, roll-stock films, and a range of butcher supplies. In addition to sales, Workers LLC provides equipment service and repair, installation and setup, and stocks replacement parts to keep production lines running.

Its customers include meat processors, food production plants, and butcher shops throughout the region. Concrete examples include supplying Hollymatic patty machines for portioning, Sipromac vacuum sealers for packaging, and Bizerba slicers and scales for weighing and labeling.

The business emphasizes responsive local service to minimize equipment downtime, a differentiator highlighted in its own messaging about reducing stress and keeping production moving without interruption.

name: World Class Woodworking
old_description: World Class Woodworking was founded by Frank D'Esposito. It is his strong attention to detail, moral values and the vision he has set forth for each and every employee's success that has built the reputation that is second to none.
about:
World Class Woodworking operates from Gilbert, Arizona. The company was founded by Frank D’Esposito, whose emphasis on detail, moral values, and a vision for employee success has shaped its reputation.

The shop produces custom wood products including cabinetry for kitchens, bars, baths, and furniture. It manufactures all of its wood door styles in-house, offers finish matching for any color, and uses a CAD shop drawing process to visualize projects before fabrication. Services span cabinet refacing, refinishing, full replacement, and new builds for both residential and commercial spaces, with installation performed by the same team.

The company serves homeowners undertaking remodels as well as commercial clients such as offices and hospitality venues. Cabinet refacing is highlighted as a fast-growing segment of the remodeling industry, allowing clients to refresh existing layouts without full demolition. Projects range from single-door repairs to complete kitchen transformations.

World Class Woodworking differentiates itself through hand-picked material suppliers—such as Decospan’s finest oak collection—and a commitment that no job is too small or too large. The founder’s stated focus on employee success and supplier relationships underpins its approach to quality and service.

name: World Finer Foods, Inc.
old_description: Max H. Ries, a German immigrant who operated a textile firm in his native Munich, left Germany in 1939 and had intended to develop a similar company in Chicago. But when he arrived in the U.S., he believed he would be better off importing food. In 1947, he founded Reese Finer Foods, and its major brand “Reese” quickly became the leading brand of specialty foods in the U.S.
about:
World Finer Foods is headquartered in Bloomfield, New Jersey. The company traces its roots to 1947 when German immigrant Max H. Ries founded Reese Finer Foods after arriving in the United States in 1939. Originally intending to establish a textile business, Ries pivoted to food importing and built the Reese brand into a specialty-food label.

Today the firm manages and markets more than 60 premium food, beverage and personal-care brands encompassing over 1,000 products. It operates as a full-service distributor and brand manager, providing sales representation, trade and consumer marketing, finance processing (order management, invoicing, promotional spend, deductions and collections) and end-to-end logistics including EDI, FDA compliance, inventory control and warehousing on an Oracle ERP platform. The company serves as the exclusive U.S. customer for its brand partners, selling to more than 350 retail and distribution accounts.

Its client base includes domestic and international specialty-food producers such as Barry’s Tea, Marmite, Bonne Maman, Dr. Woods and London Pub, as well as its own heritage Reese line. Products reach conventional grocery, specialty retailers and e-commerce channels across the United States.

The business was built on the principle that a collective network of producers, importers and distributors could grow together. That relationship-driven philosophy remains central, underscored by membership in the Specialty Food Association, The Food Institute and status as the only U.S. member of the Circle of European Specialty Food Distributors (CEISA).

name: Wyoming Authentic Beef
old_description: We do too! Each bag of our whole-muscle Angus Beef Jerky proudly displays the name of the Wyoming Ranch where the beef was locally sourced and is made with just 9 ingredients or less. Taste the Wyoming difference for yourself!
about:
Wyoming Authentic Beef operates from Cody, Wyoming, producing whole-muscle Angus beef jerky and snack products. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders' names in the provided materials, nor does it specify an ownership structure such as family-, veteran-, or woman-owned. Its origin story centers on a commitment to transparency: each package bears the name of the Wyoming ranch where the cattle were raised.

The company manufactures grass-fed, all-natural beef jerky, beef sticks, and beef bites in flavors including Original, Peppered, Honey, Sweet & Spicy, Cowboy Hickory Smoked, Wild Ginger, Original Jalapeño, Honey BBQ, and Fired Up Jalapeño. Products are formulated with nine ingredients or fewer — the Sweet & Spicy jerky uses seven — and contain no added hormones, antibiotics, MSG, nitrites, nitrates, or artificial ingredients. No facility size, headcount, equipment list, or production volumes are published.

Wyoming Authentic Beef sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site, offering free shipping on U.S. orders over $75 (excluding Alaska and Hawaii). No wholesale, foodservice, or industrial customers are identified in the source material.

The brand differentiates itself through ranch-level traceability, minimal-ingredient recipes, and a stated "Code of the West" ethos emphasizing courage, fairness, and keeping promises. These values, rather than certifications or technical capabilities, form the core of its market positioning.

name: Wyoming Fudge Company LLC
old_description: Founded by Kristy Sims, Wyoming Fudge Company is a proud, female-owned small business built on a lifelong passion for premium sweets. Made fresh in Gillette, every batch blends real butter, fresh cream, and time-honored recipes to bring a sweet taste of the West straight to your table.
about:
Wyoming Fudge Company LLC operates from Gillette, Wyoming, where it celebrated a soft opening on January 12, 2025. The business is woman-owned, founded by Kristy Sims, who first pursued a fudge shop in Pinedale years earlier before closing it to focus on a long-running office supply venture. After selling that store in 2025, she returned to confectionery, purchasing a building in Gillette to be near family and rebuilding the operation from the ground up.

The company produces handcrafted fudge in small batches using real butter, fresh cream, and traditional recipes. Its product line spans cheesecake-inspired assortments, candy-infused flavors, chocolate swirls, and seasonal offerings such as pumpkin latte and pumpkin pecan. Production details such as facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not publicly disclosed.

Wyoming Fudge Company serves three primary channels: wholesale partnerships with boutiques, gift shops, and specialty markets across Wyoming; corporate gifting programs that provide custom-branded boxes and dessert displays for businesses and private events; and fundraising programs for schools, sports teams, and non-profit organizations. Retail partners are mapped on the company's website.

Sims frames the venture as a lifelong passion for premium sweets and a way to bring a taste of the West to customers. The business also highlights its family's connection to spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 (SCA2), using its platform to raise awareness and support research through the National Ataxia Foundation.

name: Wyoming Welding & Machine LLC
old_description: Our customers say we are their Best Vendor because we provide them with the Best Service of all their vendors. We do this by being a team of A-Players who are passionate about being the best we can, guided by our Core Values and our QMS. We provide the Best Service and Highest Quality laser cut, formed, machined, and welded parts or assemblies to customers in the chemical, marine, energy, construction, aerospace, and industrial products industries.
about:
Wyoming Welding & Machine LLC operates from Sheridan, Wyoming, where founder Daniel Johlman started the company out of a desire to build a wider variety of challenging projects. What began as a personal passion for fabrication has grown into a full-service metal fabrication shop serving customers across the region.

The shop provides laser cutting, forming, machining, welding, and assembly as a turnkey operation. A Trumpf fiber laser handles mild steel up to 1 inch, stainless up to 3/4 inch, aluminum up to 5/8 inch, and titanium, copper, and brass up to 3/8 inch. The company processes thousands of pounds of titanium annually and delivers structural steel packages for multi-million-dollar residential and commercial projects, along with architectural metalwork coordinated with design firms and general contractors.

Customers span chemical, marine, energy, construction, aerospace, and industrial product sectors, as well as architectural and structural markets in Wyoming and Montana. General contractors rely on the firm for structural steel fabrication and erection, while design and engineering firms engage the shop for design-to-production integration on custom metal projects.

Johlman states he founded the business to pursue more challenging builds and to create a company that serves customers better than they have been served before, emphasizing a commitment to expanding capabilities and team development alongside project growth.

name: X-L Plastics Inc
old_description: X-L Plastics offers an array of sizes to accommodate our customers, as well as the capability to manufacture products to exact specifications. Our main products include a variety of packaging material, such as carton & drum liners, textile coverings, and mattress bags.
about:
X-L Plastics Inc operates from Clifton, New Jersey, where it produces polyethylene film and bags for packaging applications. The company runs its extrusion and converting operations serving customers across the Northeast and beyond.

The firm specializes in custom and stock packaging materials, including carton and drum liners, textile coverings, mattress bags, and Gaylord and box liners in both vented and non-vented configurations. With a workforce of 175 employees, X-L Plastics handles extrusion of polyethylene film and bags, offering custom design services where clients provide exact measurements for liners and coverings.

Its products reach the bakery, industrial, and janitorial sectors. Bakery bags are designed to preserve fresh-from-the-oven quality, while industrial and janitorial bags are built for heavy-duty use. The company also supplies liners for bulk containers and protective coverings for textiles.

X-L Plastics emphasizes environmental responsibility, stating that it encourages recycling and works to reduce waste in its operations. The ability to manufacture to exact specifications and provide a wide range of sizes is presented as a core differentiator for customers needing tailored packaging solutions.

name: Y.C. Cable (YC Cable USA)
old_description: Custom cable assembly and wire harness manufacturer since 1985
about:
Founded in Taiwan in 1985 as a monitor cable specialist, Y.C. Cable entered the U.S. OEM market in 1991 and established Y.C. Cable USA Inc. in Fremont, California, in 1997. The company is headquartered in Fremont, California.

Y.C. Cable manufactures custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses, offering processes that include wire cutting, stripping, crimping, solder termination, connector assembly, harness assembly, shielding, overmolding, heat-shrink application, labeling, and electrical testing. The company operates globally with locations in Fremont, Irvine, and Piscataway in the United States, as well as New Taipei City, Taiwan, and Dongguan, China, supporting prototype, NPI, build-to-print, and repeat production.

The company serves OEMs in AI and data centers, automation and robotics, medical and healthcare equipment, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial equipment, and telecom and communications. Examples include high-speed, high-density cables for GPU servers; high-flex cables for robotic arms; medical diagnostic and monitoring equipment cables; automotive sensor, lighting, and infotainment harnesses; and USB Type-C and Lightning cables for consumer devices.

Y.C. Cable emphasizes its end-to-end NPI process, which moves programs from engineering design review and DFM through component sourcing, production planning, inspection, and final testing. The company highlights its multi-site quality certifications—including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001—and its ability to support both quick-turn prototypes and high-volume manufacturing under customer-approved documentation.
